_doc: The release gate, as data. scripts/gate.mjs runs it (npm run gate = full repeats; npm test = --once; npm run test:quick = --tier quick).
Groups run in this order. Inside a group, pass k runs every entry whose repeat >= k (so statics once, then the smokes twice, as the legacy gate.sh did).
entry: name (the gate line label), suite (repo-relative), args, env, repeat (full-gate count; --once forces 1), clock (static | real | fake: only static and fake
entries may run in parallel under --jobs N; real-clock suites always run alone), runIn 'build' (the frozen core quartet runs from a copy next to the built game.js),
tiers (named subsets), when ({file: repo-relative path that must exist} or {env: variable that must be set}; otherwise the entry prints SKIP).
steps: commands that are not suites (exit 0 = pass). helpers: files under tests/ that are not suites (r_gate checks every other .js under the suite dirs is listed).
Every suite prints 'N passed, M failed' as its last line and exits 1 on any failure. Print check names, not source text or the og_trace fixtures (generated digests).
